# Squadboard documentation index

Machine-readable entry point for the Squadboard documentation site.

- [Agents](/squadboard/docs/app-reference/agents) - Team roster, routing configuration, and team portability
- [Apps](/squadboard/docs/app-reference/apps) - Browse and install Squad Apps to Squadboard
- [Board](/squadboard/docs/app-reference/board) - Kanban board with real-time collaboration and issue tracking
- [Ceremonies](/squadboard/docs/app-reference/ceremonies) - Automation workflows, execution history, and audit trails
- [Consult](/squadboard/docs/app-reference/consult) - Chat workspace for queries, brainstorming, and context exploration
- [Costs](/squadboard/docs/app-reference/costs) - Month-to-date LLM spend dashboard
- [Dashboard](/squadboard/docs/app-reference/dashboard) - Project health, metrics, and performance overview
- [Diagnostics & Heartbeat](/squadboard/docs/app-reference/diagnostics-heartbeat) - System health checks and automation sweeper monitoring
- [Flow](/squadboard/docs/app-reference/flow) - Agent lineage and issue swimlanes for project-wide visibility
- [Inbox](/squadboard/docs/app-reference/inbox) - Review and manage captured items awaiting action
- [App Reference](/squadboard/docs/app-reference/index) - Complete reference guide to every page and feature in the Squadboard UI
- [Live Run Viewer](/squadboard/docs/app-reference/live-run-viewer) - Monitor real-time agent run execution
- [MCP Servers](/squadboard/docs/app-reference/mcp-servers) - Configure Model Context Protocol servers for tool integrations
- [Now](/squadboard/docs/app-reference/now) - Global live dashboard of all active sessions and workflows
- [Project Picker](/squadboard/docs/app-reference/project-picker) - Create or connect Squad projects to Squadboard
- [Settings](/squadboard/docs/app-reference/settings) - Project configuration hub with 10 sections
- [Skills](/squadboard/docs/app-reference/skills) - Manage skills your agents can use
- [Templates](/squadboard/docs/app-reference/templates) - Reusable ceremony, team, and project templates
- [Tools](/squadboard/docs/app-reference/tools) - External tool registry for agent integrations
- [Architecture](/squadboard/docs/developer-guide/architecture) - The main services, data flow, user sequences, and invariants behind Squadboard.
- [Contributing docs](/squadboard/docs/developer-guide/contributing-docs) - How to edit and validate the Docusaurus docs site.
- [Developer Guide](/squadboard/docs/developer-guide/index) - Architecture, contribution, and local development notes for Squadboard.
- [Agents and workspaces](/squadboard/docs/features/agents-and-workspaces) - Agent origins, skill addenda, Consult behavior, and workspace isolation.

- [Workflow engine](/squadboard/docs/features/workflow-engine) - Durable workflow execution, recovery, retries, and step orchestration.
